Content Evidence Workbench

Compare deterministic lexical and latent retrieval over a clean-room synthetic corpus or one bounded visitor file. Every result retains its exact source text, character offsets, and SHA-256 citation. Privacy: visitor files remain only in the active notebook runtime. The workbench does not fetch source URLs, call providers, or persist uploaded content. Use the WASM build when browser-only execution is required.
